dataset.feature_semantics: five-frame concatenated log-mel vectors; 64 mel bins; raw reconstruction targets

recovered_preprocessing.warning: input and target use different numerical domains by construction

bounded_256_anomalous_validation.note: MSE is reconstruction error, not anomaly-detection accuracy

blockers: Current result schemas and reports encode classification accuracy/cross-entropy rather than task-defined reconstruction metrics.
Kernel/bias conversion leaves 992 trainable alpha/beta/BatchNorm auxiliaries in unresolved float formats.
Anomaly evaluation requires a separately specified normal/anomalous protocol and threshold-free ROC-AUC or independently calibrated threshold.
minimum_next_step: Introduce a reviewed task-metric schema with reconstruction MSE/sample-error distributions and explicit target preprocessing, then validate an exact eligible representation without coercing auxiliary tensors.
